why_stay_here.title: Why Stay Here
why_stay_here.summary: Four Seasons Peninsula Papagayo is one of the best bases in Guanacaste for travelers looking to combine luxury accommodations with unforgettable outdoor experiences. Its location provides easy access to volcanoes, wildlife, waterfalls, beaches and private adventures while maintaining the comfort and service of a world-class resort.

editorial.description: Four Seasons Resort Costa Rica at Peninsula Papagayo is an ultra-luxury coastal retreat combining beaches, wellness, dining, golf and access to private Guanacaste adventures. faq.q: Which airport is best for Four Seasons Papagayo?
faq.a: Guanacaste Airport (LIR) is the most convenient international airport for the resort. A pre-arranged private transfer is usually the simplest arrival option.

faq.q: How long is the transfer from Guanacaste Airport?
faq.a: Wild Papagayo generally estimates approximately 35–45 minutes, depending on traffic and the exact pickup and drop-off points.

faq.q: Can guests take private day tours from Four Seasons Papagayo?
faq.a: Yes. Private tours can depart from the resort to wildlife areas, hanging bridges, volcano regions, waterfalls and other Guanacaste attractions.

faq.q: Is Four Seasons Papagayo suitable for families?
faq.a: Yes. The resort combines family-oriented amenities with coastal settings and private excursions that can be adapted to different ages.
Not necessarily. Travelers planning mostly resort time and guided excursions often prefer airport transfers and tour transportation instead of keeping a rental vehicle for the full stay.
